text:
nina: FYI customer reported being billed twice when a streaming call invoked a tool_call and the client reconnected after we returned a truncated EOF. ledger shows two toolcall rows. repro attached.

sam: that's bad. are toolcall charges separate from stream token charges in the ledger? i always thought toolcalls should be charged once on ack.

omar: what's our canonical "ack" today? sidecar emits tool_call_ack when the external call completes successfully.

julia: the truncation path currently emits stream_eof_trunc and never emits ack, leaving a provisional state. a reconnect can re-run the toolcall and create a second ack -> duplicate charge.

lia: can we treat toolcalls like provisional prefix charges? create provisional ledger entries and only commit on ack.

sam: provisional + backend fingerprint dedupe seems right. many customers don't send idempotency keys. we need a server-side fingerprint: session + tool_name + args hash.

nina: in this case they're calling an external embedding vendor via tool_call; no idempotency. backend fingerprinting required.

ops-bot: quick idea: fingerprint = sha256(session_id + "|" + tool_name + "|" + canonicalize(args)); store on provisional entry with TTL 5m.

omar: migration questions: what about existing provisional-like rows? and console UX needs to avoid showing provisional as final charges.

julia: console change: show "provisional" badge on ledger rows, default-hide them, allow ops to confirm or refund. add billing report filter exclude_provisional=true by default.

lia: edge cases: reconnect may resume mid-toolcall and produce partial tokens. attribute partial tokens to the provisional entry if fingerprint matches, otherwise new entry.

sam: proposed flow:
1) sidecar emits tool_call_start -> create provisional ledger row with fingerprint and provisional=true.
2) on tool_call_ack -> commit provisional row (provisional=false, attach final token counts).
3) on reconnect within grace window (default 5s) if fingerprint matches, attach resumed tokens to existing provisional row and suppress additional toolcall entry.
4) if no ack before TTL, tombstone provisional entry and treat as failed (no charge).

nina: grace window should be route-configurable; some external tools are slow. keep audit trail linking provisional->commit.

julia: i'll draft console copy + badge and example billing SQL to exclude provisional rows unless include_provisional=true.

sam: fingerprint pseudocode:
```
fingerprint = sha256(session_id + "|" + tool_name + "|" + canonicalize(args))
ledger.insert({session_id, fingerprint, provisional: true, created_at: now(), route, debug_meta})
```

omar: impl notes: sidecar must emit tool_call_start with fingerprint and tool_call_ack with same fingerprint. if missing, compute in server before ledger insert.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: sidecar will emit tool_call_fingerprint and provisional ledger rows -> canary at 03:00 UTC on 10% traffic. :rocket:

nina: after canary run a reconciliation job to find mismatches provisional->final. i'll own the check and report.

lia: also consider auto-flagging duplicates: if two final commits share a fingerprint within 1m, auto-flag or auto-refund depending on token delta.

sam: next actions: 1) spec events (tool_call_start/tool_call_ack/tool_call_tombstone) + fingerprint contract (omar/julia), 2) ledger schema: add provisional + fingerprint (sam/omar), 3) console UX for provisional visibility (julia), 4) canary deploy (deploy-bot), 5) reconciliation job + refund rules (nina/lia).

julia: i'll open a PR with UX mocks and queries.

nina: thanks folks. i'll post repro & timeline here once canary is live. :pray:
